meta.name: cyberedge-report-findings
meta.description: Report and query evidence-backed security findings from authorized CyberEdge Tasks. Use for versioned scanner adapters that classify existing Observations, never for arbitrary command or PoC execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 报告和查询有证据支持的安全发现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要记录和查询授权安全测试中的发现
copy.tagline_en: Report and query evidence-backed security findings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to document and query findings from authorized security tests

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可以报告来自授权 CyberEdge 任务的、基于证据的安全发现，并查询已有发现。它只操作有证据支持的观察，不执行命令或修改范围。
howto.when: 当用户需要根据已完成或运行中任务中的观测记录来报告安全发现时触发。通常是在安全扫描后，需要将观测分类为发现时。

say.text: 报告发现，探测器是adapter-1，规则ID是rule-123
say.note: 创建一个新发现或刷新已有发现

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can report evidence-backed security findings from authorized CyberEdge tasks and query existing findings. It only operates on evidence-supported observations and does not execute commands or modify scope.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to report a security finding based on an observation from a running or completed task. Typically used after a security scan to classify observations into findings.

say_en.text: Report a finding with detector adapter-1 and rule ID rule-123
say_en.note: Creates a new finding or refreshes an existing one

say_en.text: Query all findings for task task-abc
